title: Polish Fruit Pilaf
description: A simple and flavorful pilaf dish with dried fruits, perfect as a side or light dessert.

ingredients.name: Dried fruit
ingredients.notes: mix of cranberries, raisins and cherries

ingredients.name: Fruit
ingredients.notes: fresh or dried apricots or prunes

instructions: Heat the pilaf according to package instructions.
Add the dried fruit to the pilaf and mix well.
If using, heat the milk in a separate pan and pour it over the pilaf mixture.
Add the fresh fruit and honey to the pilaf mixture and mix well.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
